verses.pali: “Sarūpā, bhikkhave, uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā, no arūpā.
verses.english: “Bad, unskillful qualities, mendicants, arise with form, not without form.

verses.pali: Tasseva rūpassa pahānā evaṁ te pāpakā akusalā dhammā na hontī”ti.
verses.english: By giving up that form, those bad, unskillful qualities do not occur.”
